title: Agent society charter
description: Declarative roster, turn protocol, budgets, and stop conditions for an agent society (K6.1). Loaded by orchestration/society_charter.py and run with `python main.py --society CHARTER.yaml --goal "..."`.

meta.description: Optional documentation block; ignored by the runtime.

id.description: Society identifier; also the default session slug.

goal.description: Default goal used when --goal / TASK is omitted on the CLI.

protocol.description: Turn protocol. v1 drives round_robin; `hierarchical` is accepted as an alias that still takes round-robin turns (see config/workflows/workflow_society_hierarchical_panel.yaml for a real CrewAI hierarchical crew).

interaction_mode.description: Charter interaction mode (see docs/adr/0001-agent-societies-v1.md). v1 drives `blackboard` and `delegate_rpc`; `handoff`, `crew_delegation`, and `hierarchical` are declarative only.

max_turns.description: Hard cap on member turns for one society run.

max_delegations.description: Hard cap on delegate_task calls across the whole run.

min_turns.description: Minimum turns before the society controller may stop the run early. Defaults to one full round (roster size).

members.description: Society roster. Each member must resolve to an agent-provider catalog entry.

stop_when.description: Stop conditions evaluated against each turn's output. Any match ends the run.

tools.description: Tool ids offered to the society. v1 recognizes `delegate_task` (inline child step) and `k8s_delegate_task` (Kubernetes worker Job). Unknown ids are ignored with a warning.

mcp_providers.description: MCP catalog ids allowed for every member unless a member narrows the list.

agent_provider_id.description: Catalog id from config/agent_providers (or a merged extra catalog dir). The entry should carry `society_capable: true`.

role.description: Society role, e.g. facilitator, domain_expert, critic. `facilitator` is the default target of `facilitator_posts` stop conditions.

charge.description: Extra per-member instructions injected into that member's turn description.

can_delegate.description: Attach the delegate_task tool to this member's turns (still bounded by max_delegations).

mcp_providers.description: MCP catalog ids for this member only (overrides the society-level list).

oneOf.description: Shorthand form: `<role>_posts: PHRASE` (e.g. `facilitator_posts: FINAL_RECOMMENDATION`) or `any_posts: PHRASE`.

role.description: Role that must post the phrase; omit or use `any` for any member.

posts.description: Case-insensitive substring that ends the run when it appears in a turn's output.
